暂无任务。先检查设备，确认 SSH 连接和板卡状态。: No tasks yet. Check the device to verify SSH and board status.
这里只统计代理和网页隧道；SSH 终端独立连接，可检查设备验证 SSH 是否可用: Only proxy and web tunnels are tracked here. SSH terminals connect separately; use Check device to verify SSH.
操作时先保存此环境的 SSH 与网络配置，随后在对应板卡执行。: Actions save this workspace's SSH and network settings before running on its board.
安装到当前环境专属目录，不替换系统 Node.js。先查询版本，再选择安装。: Install into this workspace's private directory without replacing system Node.js. Query versions before installing.
退出工作台后保留板卡后台服务: Keep board services running after exit
。关闭主窗口仅缩至托盘。: . Window close behavior follows your settings.
选择已安装的 Code.exe 创建固定副本。独立设置不会覆盖日常 VS Cod: Choose an installed Code.exe to create a pinned copy. Private settings preserve your regular VS Code configuration. Imported server packages require official SHA-256 verification.
电脑代理通过 SSH 反向转发到板卡，中断后自动尝试重连。修改设置前先断开本地连: The PC proxy is forwarded to the board over SSH and reconnects automatically. Disconnect local tunnels before changing settings.
SSH 私钥（空值使用系统身份）: SSH private key (blank for system identity)
导入官方 OAuth 凭据，或在“设置 → 认证”中完成设备码登录。凭据在本机加: Import official OAuth credentials or use device login in Settings → Authentication. Credentials are encrypted locally and written to the board when synced.
未选择文件，保留已有凭据: No file selected; keep existing credentials
请先查询并选择版本: Query and select a version first
ChatGPT 官方账号 · 无需 API Key: Official ChatGPT account · No API key required
在板卡终端完成授权，凭据保留在此环境专属目录: Authorize in the board terminal; credentials stay in this workspace's private directory
配置模型与 API Key 后使用: Configure a model and API key to get started
。保存和使用仅更新本地配置，同步后才写入板卡。: . Saving and selecting update local settings; sync to apply them on the board.
同一份 New API 配置可供各 CLI 工具使用；应用按工具生成请求格式，接: Reuse one New API configuration across CLI tools. The app generates the tool's request format; your endpoint must support it.
使用 ChatGPT 官方账号，无需填写 API Key: Use your official ChatGPT account without an API key
应用根据当前 CLI 工具自动配置接口格式，填写供应商提供的请求地址和模型名称。: The app configures the API format for this CLI tool. Enter your provider's endpoint and model name.
连接你的板卡，进入创造的节奏。: Connect your board. Find your creative rhythm.
这里只统计应用维护的代理和网页隧道；外部 SSH 终端独立连接，不以隧道状态判断: Only app-managed proxy and web tunnels are tracked. External SSH terminals connect separately; tunnel state does not indicate SSH availability.
填写或选择供应商提供的模型名称: Enter or select your provider's model name
已保存的密钥在此处遮罩显示；留空保留原密钥，更换请求地址需填写对应密钥。: Saved keys are masked. Leave blank to keep the existing key; changing the endpoint requires its matching key.
默认遮罩显示，点击眼睛查看明文。: Masked by default. Click the eye to reveal.
以下配置由表单自动生成；同步到远程设备后生效。: Generated from this form. Sync to the remote device to apply.
选择应用启动与关闭窗口时的行为。: Choose how the app starts and what happens when you close its window.
登录 Windows 后自动运行 Edge Switch。: Run Edge Switch automatically when you sign in to Windows.
开启后点击关闭按钮会隐藏到系统托盘，关闭此选项则退出应用。: When enabled, closing the window hides the app in the system tray. Otherwise, closing exits the app.
切换后立即生效，保存后下次启动继续使用。: Applies immediately and is remembered for the next launch.
为唱片工作台选择配色，保存后下次启动继续使用。: Choose a studio color scheme. Your choice is saved for the next launch.
选择出现在首页滚动列表中的 AI 工具；VS Code 与 SSH 终端始终保留: Choose AI tools for the home list. VS Code and the SSH terminal are always available.
系统启用减少动态效果时，唱片也会自动停止旋转。: The record also stops when your system requests reduced motion.
电脑代理通过 SSH 反向转发供板卡使用。修改路由前，请先断开当前环境的代理与网: The board uses the PC proxy over reverse SSH forwarding. Disconnect this workspace's proxy and web tunnels before changing routes.
账号认证按远程工作环境保存。完成授权后，可在模型服务列表中启用官方账号。: Authentication is stored per remote workspace. After authorization, select the official account in model services.
首次使用请先在工作环境的 AI 工具中安装 Codex CLI，并配置好 SSH: Install Codex CLI in your workspace's AI tools and configure SSH first. Sign in opens the board's SSH terminal. Follow the prompts to authorize on the official website; the app does not collect your password. View or cancel the task in Logs.
Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Harness 与 OpenCod: Manage official accounts and API providers for other CLI tools in model services. Harness requires an API provider.
连接配置按环境保存；编辑操作不会修改板卡上的工程文件。: Connection settings are saved per workspace. Editing does not change project files on the board.
查看设备状态、安装工具或维护远程编辑器。: Inspect the board, install tools, or maintain the remote editor.
面向 Linux 板卡的远程 AI 开发工作台。: A remote AI development studio for Linux boards.
通过 SSH 安装与启动开发工具，配置代理网络，管理和切换模型 API 供应商。: Install and launch tools over SSH, configure proxies, and manage model API providers.
版本检查来自 GitHub Releases；下载与安装由你在发布页确认。: Updates are checked on GitHub Releases. Download and install from the releases page.
浏览器里的 AI 工作空间: An AI workspace in your browser
任务已提交，正在等待板卡响应…: Task submitted. Waiting for the board…
将发送真实推理请求，可能消耗 API 余额或账号额度。是否继续？: This sends a real inference request and may use API credits or account quota. Continue?
停止 Harness 会中断当前服务和可能进行中的任务。是否继续？: Stopping Harness interrupts its service and any running tasks. Continue?
将断开网页和代理隧道，使用这些连接的工具会受影响；板卡后台服务保留。是否继续？: Disconnect web and proxy tunnels? Tools using these connections will be affected. Background services on the board will keep running.
停止本地等待和 SSH 操作；远端操作可能仍在进行，请随后刷新设备核对。: Stop waiting locally and stop SSH operations? Remote operations may continue. Refresh the device afterward to check.
本机账号 · Web 与 Desktop 共用: Local account · Shared by Web and Desktop
尚未登录 DeepSeek Harness 账号: No DeepSeek Harness account signed in
同步账号到当前板卡并启用: Sync account to this board and enable
当前板卡已选择账号通道: Account access selected for this board
可在授权中心识别本机 Harness 账号，并同步到当前板卡使用账号模型。: Detect the local Harness account in Authorization Center and sync it to this board to use account models.
自动读取本机 DSH_HOME（默认 ~/.dsh）的账号授权。同步后在远程 H: Automatically reads account authorization from local DSH_HOME (default ~/.dsh). After syncing, select DeepSeek account models in remote Harness to use that account's credits. The token is not used as a normal API key. Stop running Harness before switching.
浏览器登录在本机打开官方授权网页，完成后加密保存到当前工作环境；设备码登录通过板: Browser login opens the official authorization page locally and saves encrypted credentials for this workspace. Device-code login runs through the board's SSH terminal. Each workspace stores one ChatGPT authorization; import credentials through the management entry.
管理官方账号授权与工具接入，按工作环境独立保存。: Manage official accounts and tool access separately for each workspace.
授权成功后，前往模型服务启用对应账号。: After authorization, enable the account in model services.
账号授权仅用于当前工作环境。: This authorization is used only in the current workspace.
登录官方账号或导入凭据后，即可使用 ChatGPT 订阅。: Sign in or import credentials to use your ChatGPT subscription.
首次使用请先安装远程 Codex CLI 并配置 SSH。设备码登录会打开板卡的: Install Codex CLI on the remote device and configure SSH first. Device login opens the board’s SSH terminal; follow its instructions to authorize in your browser. Each workspace stores one ChatGPT authorization. Signing in or importing again replaces existing credentials.
官方账号请在板卡终端完成授权，登录状态以工具提示为准；API 供应商可在模型服务: Authorize official accounts in the board terminal and check login status in the tool. Manage API providers in model services.
通过模型服务配置 API Key，统一供应商可供多个工具复用。: Configure API keys in model services. Unified providers can be reused across tools.
导入官方 OAuth 凭据，或在侧边栏的授权中心完成设备码登录。凭据在本机加密保: Import official OAuth credentials or use device login in Authorization Center in the sidebar. Credentials are encrypted locally and written to the board when synced.
仅统计当前环境内已记录用量的模型请求。新增输入、输出、缓存读取与写入分别计数；费: Includes model requests with recorded usage in this workspace. Fresh input, output, cache reads and writes are counted separately. Costs show only USD amounts recorded in logs; missing costs appear as —. These are not provider bills.
在当前板卡环境使用 AI 工具后，点击刷新同步。: Use an AI tool in this device workspace, then refresh usage.
